steps.text: Mix ground beef, onion, garlic, Worcestershire sauce, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper together in a large bowl until well combined. Cover and refrigerate for 2 to 4 hours.
When ready to cook, preheat an outdoor grill for high heat and lightly oil the grate. Remove beef mixture from the refrigerator and form into six 1/2-inch-thick patties.
Cook on the preheated grill until no longer pink in the center, about 3 minutes per side. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 160 degrees F (70 degrees C).

raw_recipe.headline: Garlic and Onion Burgers
raw_recipe.description: For the best garlic and onion burgers, after mixing your ground beef with seasonings, refrigerate it for at least two to four hours before cooking!

review.reviewBody: These turned out great! I served them with swiss cheese, grilled onions and mushrooms on top. I also added 1 teaspoon of Aleppo Pepper & 1 teaspoon seasoning salt. To help the patties stay together I used 1/2 cup of oatmeal and 1 egg.

Flavors were outstanding! Maybe the people who thought otherwise used dried minced onions? I used a fresh onion and minced it up. I made just over 6lbs and ran out of Worcestershire so I used Dale's Seasoning to round out the amt I needed. Other than that, I followed the recipe exactly. Also, it is key to handle the meat as little as possible. After I mixed everything together (using wooden spoons kind of folding it in) I put into the fridge. I'd made it the day prior to needing. The day of, I took a 3/4 measuring cup and scooped out some of the meat. The measuring cup was just slightly overfilled. Then I gently pressed together into a ball. I placed the ball on a hot griddle (about 450) for 30 seconds. Flattened with spatula. Let it cook for 2 minutes. Flipped it, and let it cook for 3 more minutes. It's the "smash burger" method I read about in my Food & Wine magazine. SO GOOD!!! The cooking method was great but the meat was just fantastic. I was afraid because I could smell the italian seasonings but when I was eating the burger patty (tried the night prior with just the meat & bread to really see if it was good) it just tasted like meaty goodness. Wouldn't change a thing. In fact, I'm totally gonna use this exact recipe & altered cooking method to make hamburger steaks. Make a nice onion mushroom brown gravy to go over these bad boys? Oh yeah, good eating. I could not be happier with this simple yet flavorful beef patty. THANK YOU!

Loved this recipe. Instead of following to the T I added 1 Tablespoon Grey Poupon and did 2 tablespoons of Worcestershire sauce. Then I actually fried it in two table spoons of EVOO on the stove because I don't own a grill in my apartment. Definitely making these again, hopefully I can try them on the grill one day. Roommates and boyfriend loved them too!

These were excellent! We loved them. I used ground turkey and since my eldest son has developed an onion alergy, I used a couple of tablespoons of dry onion soup mix. Just a quick tip, if you have a griddle, make them on there (400 deg). They were all done at the same time. Great time saver and no over cooking trying to keep them warm.

OMG! These burgers are to die for! They are juicy and flavorful. Per other reviews, I used Montreal steak seasoning in place of Italian seasoning. I used ground chuck, used my garlic press so it wouldn't be too chunky; 3 finely chopped shallots, omitted the salt and added fresh chopped basil. YUM..so good. Will be my only burger recipe from now on and can't wait to make for company. Do not over-mix meat or over-handle when forming burgers. You don't want them too dense. Mine were formed into loose patties.
ya these were awsome , i grilled them on charcoal grill , made some garlic buns , put on some bacon and fresh colby cheese . look out!

These were delicious! The only change I made was to add an egg and a half-cup of bread crumbs (to a doubled recipe), although that may not have been necessary. Also, while on the grill, as well as using bbq sauce, I poured a little wine on each one. The Italian seasoning was just right for our taste buds. Mmmmm!

i used this recipe but was lacking; second time i used 1/2 pork 1/2 ground chuck and used some italian seasoned bread crumbs and i liked an egg mixed in for glue, then we had great flavor. even the todlers loved this - only 3 stars because i had to adjust this too much

Cooked them slowly on the stove and then cranked it up at the end to have a nice crunch on them. We will definitely make it again. I read the other reviews and decided to cut the Italian seasoning in half but will do the full amount next time because it could've use it. 
Everyone has different taste buds and I like things hot, spicy and full flavored. :)

Sometimes simple is best and that's certainly the case with these burgers. I made two minor changes, I micro planed the onion and garlic and I cooked them in a cast iron skillet. I can't wait to try these on the grill!
Great recipe, I made them into meatballs and baked them in 180 degree oven for 35 minutes, came out great and the amount of fat that drained out was at least a 1/2 cup.

I wanted to love these because they were so easy to make but I found them to be nothing special, just a very salty burger with minimal other flavorings (could be the salt just drowned them out). There wasn't anything bad about them but there wasn't anything great either. I don't think I would bother making them again.
i cooked it just like the recipe said , i made my burgers thicker and used sesime sedd buns

Good burger! I grated my onion in because it adds so much flavor. I forgot to add the italian seasoning, and wouldn't next time anyway, because that reminds me of one of my meatball recipes. Thank you for a simple burger!
Good - moist
Seemed fine. Unfortunately I didn't get to put the seasoned meat in the fridge beforehand. I did add an egg and the patty didn't fall apart.
Great!
I thought this made for flavorful hamburgers with the nice crunch of the onions. Quick and easy! I would make them again! I let them marinate for about 3 hours before cooking.
Made some grilled onions and put those and swiss cheese on top. I'll probably leave out the Italian seasoning next time and maybe add something to hold the burgers together better.
We were looking to spice up our burger routine. This recipe did the trick. Grilled with a slice of pepper jack cheese = perfection!
